answer_1.quote: An important application of online alignment is lexically constrained translation which allows injection of domain-specific terminology and other phrasal constraints during decoding . Other applications include preservation of markups between the source and target , and supporting source word edits in summarization .

answer_2.quote: We then report the Alignment Error Rate (AER) between the gold alignments and the predicted alignments for different methods. ... we report BLEU, time to translate all test sentences, and Constraint Satisfaction Rate (CSR). ... We call this measure BLEU-C and compute it as the BLEU of the constraint (when satisfied) and a window of three words around it.
